description: Create a local Convex sales demo for Danielson School and add a dynamic zoomable teacher proficiency graph to teacher reports.
deviation_notes: The browser review found one pre-hydration form safety defect. The final fix added the native POST method and one regression test. The portfolio correction added one observation index and no new table or runtime layer. A later correction added the missing local-only pilot credentials to the login page. One graph correction preserved component rating data. A later user review required visible 1–4 averages and score colors on all rated hierarchy nodes.
